scripts.verify:calibration: npm run typecheck -w @isa-sim/calibration && npm run lint -w @isa-sim/calibration && npm test -w @isa-sim/calibration && npm run build -w @isa-sim/calibration && npm run typecheck -w @isa-sim/server && npm test -w @isa-sim/server
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n web,server "npm run dev" "npm run serve -w @isa-sim/server"
scripts.toolchains:test: tsx toolchains/scripts/emit-semantic-smoke.ts && node toolchains/scripts/toolchains.mjs test && tsx toolchains/scripts/semantic-cases.ts && tsx toolchains/scripts/cross-smoke.ts && tsx toolchains/scripts/backend-smoke.ts
scripts.verify:toolchains: tsx toolchains/scripts/emit-semantic-smoke.ts && node toolchains/scripts/toolchains.mjs verify && tsx toolchains/scripts/semantic-cases.ts && tsx toolchains/scripts/cross-smoke.ts && tsx toolchains/scripts/backend-smoke.ts
scripts.verify:native-corpus: npm run typecheck -w @isa-sim/native-benchmarks && npm run lint -w @isa-sim/native-benchmarks && npm test -w @isa-sim/native-benchmarks && npm run corpus -w @isa-sim/native-benchmarks -- verify
scripts.verify:native-corpus:full: npm run typecheck -w @isa-sim/native-benchmarks && npm run lint -w @isa-sim/native-benchmarks && npm test -w @isa-sim/native-benchmarks && npm run corpus -w @isa-sim/native-benchmarks -- verify --full
scripts.external:test: npm test -w @isa-sim/server -- external && node external/scripts/external.mjs test
scripts.verify:external: npm run contracts:build && npm run typecheck -w @isa-sim/server && npm run lint -w @isa-sim/server && npm test -w @isa-sim/server -- external && node external/scripts/external.mjs verify && node external/scripts/protocol-table.mjs --check
scripts.verify:backend: npm run typecheck -w @isa-sim/server && npm run lint -w @isa-sim/server && npm test -w @isa-sim/server && npm run build -w @isa-sim/server
scripts.verify:ooo: vitest run src/engine/ooo.test.ts src/engine/cpu.test.ts src/engine/cache.test.ts src/engine/predictor.test.ts
scripts.verify:empirical: npm run verify:empirical-runner && npm run verify:calibration
scripts.helper:test-fixture-build: cargo build --manifest-path crates/measurement-helper/Cargo.toml --features test-only-fixture --bin measurement-test-fixture && cargo build --manifest-path crates/measurement-helper/Cargo.toml --bin measurement-helper
scripts.verify:empirical-runner: npm run typecheck -w @isa-sim/contracts && npm run lint -w @isa-sim/contracts && npm test -w @isa-sim/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @isa-sim/empirical-runner && npm run lint -w @isa-sim/empirical-runner && npm run runner:build && npm run helper:test-fixture-build && npm run runner:test && npm run helper:test && npm run typecheck -w @isa-sim/server && npm run lint -w @isa-sim/server && npm test -w @isa-sim/server && npm run build -w @isa-sim/server
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:deep && npm run verify:backend && npm run verify:ooo && npm run contracts:test
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify && npm run verify:empirical && npm run verify:native-corpus && npm run verify:external && npm run verify:toolchains
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run desktop:compile
scripts.desktop:pack:win: npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --win nsis portable --publish never
scripts.desktop:pack:linux: npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --linux AppImage tar.gz --publish never
scripts.desktop:pack:mac: npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
